name: Kung Fu Theater
description: Dubbed chop-socky from the 1970s and early 80s, just like Saturday-afternoon Black Belt Theater: Sonny Chiba in The Street Fighter, Angela Mao in Lady Whirlwind, The Mystery of Chess Boxing, The 36 Crazy Fists, Raiders of the Shaolin Temple and a bunch of Bruce Lee clones. Bruceploitation Double Feature every Friday night at 10:00 pm.
curated: 2026-10-15: about 50 hours of hand-picked Hong Kong, Taiwanese and Japanese martial arts features (1971-1983), mostly the English-dubbed public-domain grindhouse prints; Blu-ray rips, multi-film re-uploads with commentary or reviews, riffs, trailers, Mandarin-only prints and modern films excluded.
